item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect partly cloudy skies with low temperatures ranging from the lower thirties to the upper thirties and only a slight chance of precipitation. Tomorrow brings partly to mostly cloudy conditions in the morning with highs from the mid-fifties to the upper fifties and minimal precipitation expected. Tomorrow night, skies remain partly to mostly cloudy with lows again in the lower thirties to upper thirties and no precipitation.
